IPT.evidence_source: [/page/27/Text/1] The Chinese version of the POP was developed to enhance optimistic explanatory style. Specifically, we expected greater improvement in explanatory style in the treatment group than in the control group at the post-test and at the follow-ups.

dxgive.evidence_source: [/page/27/Text/2] At the end of the intervention program, those children who participated in the intervention became significantly more optimistic than they were at the beginning of the program. Moreover, children in the control group did not show any statistically significant change in their level of optimism during the same period (see <u>Table 11</u> and <u>Table 12</u>).
dxgive.warning: No explicit mention of formal diagnostic criteria for inclusion or exclusion. CDI is a symptom severity measure, not a diagnostic one.
